scope: Subspace Networks Eq. 7–11 on a two-block residual network with frozen high-rank embeddings, fixed shared subspace and an independently checked Grassmann update. Dense vs compressed constrained-model trajectories are compared; arbitrary dense activation gradients are NOT claimed to reconstruct exactly. Low-rank FL implements server projection, ideal OTA sum and error feedback as OFLight-related controls. Its SVD/refresh policies are our explicit choices because the full OFLight algorithm was unavailable; no full-paper fidelity or RF/throughput claim.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
